sites.name: Pit River Campground
sites.feeText: Fee Description: . $8.00 Daily Camping fee. $12.00 Group camping fee. (one group site). $7.00 parking fee for additional vehicles . America the Beautiful, Senior and Military passes accepted. All sites are first come…
sites.about: The Pit River Recreation area is adjacent to the Pit River and has a small campground with eight campsites including tables, metal fire rings, and barbeque pits. Amenities include: two single wheelchair accessible restrooms, a kayak launch ramp, and an accessible fishing pier. Camping: $8.00/night…
